# Status

As of 2026-10-10: 55 capabilities are shipped, 3 are decided and 5 are planned. **Shipped** means it runs on `main` and is held by a named test in the repository; an item marked *unreleased* is on `main` but not yet in a tagged release. **Decided** means specified, with no runtime. **Planned** means not built. `connectors-docs` generates this page and `website/data/status.json` from one list and fails when a test it names is gone. A release page carries the source archives and Linux and macOS binaries of `connectors` and `connectors-catalog-provider`; the [changelog](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) records each change a user sees, release by release.

## Service boundary

| Capability | Status | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| [Describe and invoke](./getting-started.md) | ● shipped | An adapter service answers a typed descriptor and invokes its operations over HTTP; admission and freshness are checked before dispatch. |
| [One-hop federation](./guides/federate-adapter-services.md) | ● shipped | connectors serve puts one gateway in front of several adapter services, prefixes their operations and reports a downstream failure without retrying it. |
| [Audited v1alpha2 invoke](./concepts/governed-invocation.md) | ● shipped | A host whose service configuration names a state directory serves POST /v1alpha2/invoke: every admitted invocation is anchored in the execution audit before dispatch (since 0.35.0). |
| [The attempt a write produced](./concepts/governed-invocation.md) | ● shipped | An admitted write records its attempt before its one dispatch and answers it as mutation; a lost answer is outcome_unknown and is never sent again (since 0.35.0). |
| [Rust client for v1alpha2](./concepts/governed-invocation.md) | ● shipped | connectors_client::Client::invoke_v1alpha2 returns the attempt the host recorded and reports an older host as unsupported instead of falling back. |
| [Governed service admission](./reference/contracts/governed-service.md) | ◐ decided | Principal, tenant, grant and delegated approval on the service wire are specified; the runtime implements only the first v1alpha2 invoke binding. |

## Local runtime

| Capability | Status | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| [Setup and metadata store](./guides/set-up-the-local-cli.md) | ● shipped | setup init creates a private configuration and an Entity Runtime metadata store over Eventlog SQLite, with durable open checkpoints (since 0.33.0). |
| [Supervised adapters](./concepts/local-runtime.md) | ● shipped | A local owner starts the configured adapter executables, refuses a changed executable or configuration before provider work, and stops exact incarnations. |
| [Stopping an owner after an upgrade](./guides/set-up-the-local-cli.md#after-an-upgrade) | ● shipped | setup owner-stop asks the state directory's running owner, of any build, to drain and exit within 30 seconds, answers no_owner when none runs, and never signals a process. |
| [Configuration upgrades](./concepts/local-runtime.md) | ● shipped | After a configuration change each saved connection has one working path: revalidate, a new connection under the same instance id after an evidence lifetime change, or a new instance id after a changed provider authority or profile. |
| [Approval clock refusals](./concepts/local-runtime.md) | ● shipped | approvals clock-check names why no observation resulted: an unreachable source, a reply that does not verify against the configured key, or a source whose signed radius is too wide for approvals, each with its own next action. |
| [Saved connections](./concepts/local-runtime.md) | ● shipped | connections connect validates a credential and keeps it in Secret Service custody; revalidate, repair and revoke manage it, and an unanswered revalidation is outcome_unknown. |
| [Mounted-secret custody](./guides/set-up-the-local-cli.md) | ● shipped | An owner configuration can explicitly select read-only mounted-secret custody (mounted_secret, Linux): connect, list and a credentialed invoke run under an empty environment in a container, reading a Kubernetes-style Secret volume and writing nothing; rotation needs a revalidation. |
| [Approved writes](./concepts/local-runtime.md) | ● shipped | approvals policy-set, prepare and issue bind a write's whole input to a protected proof before the host dispatches it once. |
| [Approval-signing keys](./concepts/local-runtime.md) | ● shipped | Approval-signing keys are initialized, rotated, recovered, revoked and retired through the CLI; status reads never touch custody. |
| [Approval clock check](./concepts/local-runtime.md) | ● shipped | approvals clock-check verifies one configured Roughtime source without starting the owner or reading metadata. |
| [Consumer launch](./concepts/local-runtime.md) | ● shipped | connections launch hands one connection's protected document to a pinned consumer and refuses a launch its configuration does not admit (since 0.31.0). |
| [Operations by family](./reference/cli.md) | ● shipped | operations list --family names the operations of one contract family, such as datasource.feed/v1alpha1, with their contract and profile. |
| [JSON values in JSON answers](./reference/cli.md) | ● shipped | With --output json, invoke results and operation schemas are JSON values, not JSON text (breaking since 0.32.0). |

|---|---|---|
| [Bundles from pinned sources](./guides/build-a-catalog-bundle.md) | ● shipped | connectors-build catalog compiles a pinned OpenAPI document into a digest-verified bundle; every committed bundle matches a fresh run byte for byte. |

| [GitLab](./reference/adapters/gitlab/index.md) | ● shipped | Projects, issues, files, the repository tree, branches, tags, releases, commits, commit diffs, compares, code search, deployments, environments, pipelines, jobs, traces, merge requests and their diffs and discussions as reads; issue, merge-request (auto-merge and reopen included), note, discussion, tag and release writes under approval. |
| [GitLab CI, branch, commit and project writes](./reference/adapters/gitlab/index.md) | ● shipped | pipeline.retry, pipeline.cancel, pipeline.create, commit.create, file.update, branch.create, branch.delete and project.create under approval, each guarded on the caller's commit (project.create on the namespace path and id) and proven by GitLab's answer or a read after it; environments.list as a read; verified against fixtures, not a live GitLab. |
| [GitLab merge-request feed](./reference/adapters/catalog/contracts/feed.md) | ● shipped | GitLab binds datasource.feed/v1alpha1 as profile gitlab-merge-requests/1, checked against recorded GitLab answers (since 0.32.0). |
| [Jira Cloud](./reference/adapters/catalog/index.md) | ● shipped | Issue search by JQL, one issue by key, comments, changelogs, an issue's available transitions, a project's creatable issue types, user search, an attachment's content, and running one transition by id under a guard that reads the issue before and after it, over HTTP basic authentication (one issue, issue types and user search since 0.39.0). |
| [Binary responses](./concepts/catalog-provider.md) | ● shipped | A selection can read an answer as bytes: media type, length, SHA-256 and the bytes in base64, at most 2 MiB and refused as capacity above it, with at most three redirects, each only to an origin the selection names and the connection admits in its hosts; verified against fixtures only. |
| [Jira attachment content](./reference/adapters/catalog/index.md) | ● shipped | attachment.content reads one attachment as a binary body, directly with redirect=false or through Jira's 303 to an admitted media host; that host, api.media.atlassian.com, is inferred and not verified against a live site. |
| [Confluence Cloud](./reference/adapters/catalog/index.md) | ● shipped | Changed pages, a space's pages, one page with its body and a page's comments; exercised against local fixtures only. |
| [Confluence Cloud REST v1](./reference/adapters/catalog/index.md) | ● shipped | CQL search, changed pages by CQL, spaces, one space, a space's content, one page with its body and a page's comments under the provider id confluence-v1, from a source document this repository writes from Atlassian's v1 reference; exercised against local fixtures only. |
| [HubSpot CRM](./reference/adapters/catalog/index.md) | ● shipped | One object type's records, paged, and one record by id; exercised against local fixtures only. |
| [Zendesk Support](./reference/adapters/catalog/index.md) | ● shipped | Tickets, users and organizations changed since a start time, one of each by id, and a ticket's comments, with OAuth client credentials or an API token. |
| [Google Drive, Slides, Calendar and Gmail](./reference/adapters/catalog/index.md) | ● shipped | Reads and guarded writes from Discovery documents projected to OpenAPI, with a refresh token from browser consent; exercised against local fixtures only. |
| [Runpod pods](./reference/adapters/catalog/index.md) | ● shipped | pod.create, pods.list and pod.terminate with the API key in custody; a create without a definite answer is unknown and never sent again; verified against a local fixture only (since 0.36.0). |
| [Swagger 2.0 sources](./guides/build-a-catalog-bundle.md) | ● shipped | A Swagger 2.0 document is ingested through an exact, recorded projection to OpenAPI 3.1.0; a construct without an exact row is refused by name (since 0.37.0). |
| [Slack conversations](./reference/adapters/catalog/index.md) | ● shipped | conversations.list, conversations.history and conversations.replies with a bot token (since 0.38.0), users.list, team.info, emoji.list and auth.test, and on a second connection with a user token search.messages and the three conversation reads and users.list, which reach every conversation that user can read, the channels the bot is not in included; verified against a local fixture only. |
| [Slack messages](./reference/adapters/catalog/index.md) | ● shipped | chat.postMessage posts a message, a thread reply included, conversations.open opens a direct message to post to, and chat.update and chat.delete edit and delete a message the bot posted, each under approval after the token's auth.test read; an edit or delete Slack refuses by name (cant_update_message, cant_delete_message, message_not_found) is refused, and a dispatch without a definite answer, or any other 200 with ok false, is unknown; none is sent again; verified against a local fixture only. |
| [Slack files](./reference/adapters/catalog/index.md) | ● shipped | files.list, files.info and file.download, which reads a file's url_private on files.slack.com as a binary body with the bot token, only where the connection admits that host with the credential; verified against a local fixture only. |
| [Slack read refusals](./reference/adapters/catalog/index.md) | ● shipped | A Slack read answered 200 with ok false is refused, never returned as an empty read: Slack's error is the reason, and missing_scope and not_in_channel are forbidden, invalid_auth and its kin unauthorized, an unknown channel, thread, file or user not_found, ratelimited rate_limited with its Retry-After, a bad cursor or argument invalid_input, and any other name internal, on every JSON read of both Slack sets; verified against a local fixture only. |
| [Opsgenie alerts and incidents](./reference/adapters/catalog/index.md) | ● shipped | alerts.list and incidents.list over a creation window the caller advances, alert.get, incident.get and incident.alert_ids, read only, with the key sent as GenieKey <key>; verified against a local fixture only. |
| [Catalog index service](./reference/contracts/catalog.md) | ◐ decided | Listing and locating precompiled bundles with provenance is specified; directly configured adapters need no index. |

| Capability | Status | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| [Kubernetes reads and discovery](./reference/adapters/kubernetes/index.md) | ● shipped | resources.list, endpoints.discover and optionally hosts.discover, scoped to configured namespaces and kinds, with a saved bearer token. |

| [Kubernetes statefulsets, nodes and custom resources](./reference/adapters/kubernetes/index.md) | ● shipped | statefulsets is a configurable kind; nodes.list pages the full Node objects when node_reads is configured; custom_resources.list pages one configured namespaced custom resource collection by group, version and plural; verified against API-shaped fixtures. |
| [Kubernetes exec credential plugin](./reference/adapters/kubernetes/index.md) | ● shipped | A kubeconfig user that authenticates through an exec plugin, such as aws eks get-token, is reached when the local configuration pins the plugin by absolute path and sha256: it runs on Linux from the descriptor it was hashed through, with the kubeconfig arguments, an empty environment plus an allow-list, a deadline and an output bound, and its token is held in memory until expiry; verified with fixture plugins against a recorded API session, not a live EKS cluster. |
| [Kubernetes pod logs](./reference/adapters/kubernetes/index.md) | ● shipped | pods.logs reads a bounded tail of one container's log in a configured namespace, at most 1,000 lines and 128 KiB, when pod_logs is configured; verified against API-shaped fixtures. |
